description: Issue an in-VM admin chat command (`/ban`, `/banip`, `/unban`, `/banlist`, `/builder`, `/admin`, `/roomie`, `/visitor`, `/close`, `/qtrday`, `/setjob`, `/trace`, `/reload`, `/time`, `/tickrate`, `/speed`, `/tuning`, `/fixall`, `/testcollision`). Dispatched from `VMNetChatCmd.Execute` when `Message[0]=='/'`. Rich multi-verb op; recommend declaring one convention per command family in d87-d-admin rather than one mega-verb.
